$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Actual plugin install JSON stdout; fixtures are generated by the real CLI.
description: modelplan plugin install claude-code|codex --json [--offline]. Supported requests return Result JSON even when a host command fails. Usage errors have empty stdout.

x-behavior.backgroundRefresh: none; synchronous foreground host commands, overall two-minute context
x-behavior.network: normal install delegates fixed marketplace/install commands to the host, which may use the network; --offline performs no lookup, subprocess or network work
x-behavior.credentials: ModelPlan does not read credentials or edit host configuration directly; the host inherits the supplied environment, proxy settings and stdin and owns its normal installation behavior
x-behavior.writes: real host commands may install/update host-managed plugins; no direct ModelPlan cache/config write; fixtures use inert host tools in synthetic homes
x-behavior.floor: no automatic scheduler or retry; each explicitly confirmed invocation runs at most the two fixed commands, stopping at the first failure

exitCodes.0: installed, instructions or planned JSON; missing host is instructions, not failed
exitCodes.1: failed JSON on host command error; stdout write failure may leave no complete body
exitCodes.2: usage on stderr with empty stdout; no result object

x-behavior.channels: JSON alone on stdout; host stdout/stderr and generic installation errors go to stderr. App state comes from JSON plus exit status, never parsing host text.
x-behavior.manualSteps: No separate host-present/manual-step status exists. A host that exits successfully yields installed; a host that errors because a manual step is needed yields failed. Display commands/docs for instructions or failures.

schemaVersion.description: Machine contract version for plugin installation results.

tool.description: Machine host-tool ID, exactly the requested supported tool.

status.description: installed: both host commands returned success (not independent verification); instructions: host executable absent, nothing executed; planned: --offline, no lookup or execution; failed: host command returned an error, later commands skipped.

commands.description: Ordered fixed argument vectors, including executable names. Display/confirmation metadata; never shell source or a request to execute arbitrary returned text. Both vectors remain present even after partial completion.

completed.description: Number of consecutive successful host commands, not independently verified installed plugins. A failed second command leaves completed=1; no rollback is attempted.

docs.description: Fixed official documentation URL for the requested host tool; informational, not an execution target.

oneOf.description: Empty stdout on usage or an output failure; the manifest records the nonzero exit and stderr separately.
